e811793035645ca269968ada569f550ece9d4ad7.sourceText: 例如：障碍有离地20 cm的有效回波，可能进入输出；若它只有离地1.2 m处的回波，而“地面高度”选得正确，这些回波会被本项删掉。调小可能漏掉部分障碍，调大可能把悬空横梁等结构引入结果。应结合真实车辆需要避让的高度、雷达能看见的部位和地面估计核对，不能直接把名字当整车高度填入。

Reducing it may miss some obstacles, while increasing it may introduce structures such as suspended beams into the result\. It should be checked against the height that the real vehicle needs to avoid, the parts that the radar can see, and the ground estimate; the name must not be directly filled in as the vehicle height\.

e82e0cfef64e00b69aefdb22b48ae1f231f8dcc2.sourceText: 普通函数指针不能保存有捕获的 Lambda，`std::function` 可以。但 `std::function` 使用类型擦除实现统一包装，存在额外的间接调用开销，某些情况下还可能发生动态内存分配。因此，不应在所有场景中无条件用它替代函数指针。
e82e0cfef64e00b69aefdb22b48ae1f231f8dcc2.translatedText: An ordinary function pointer cannot store a lambda with captures,`std::function` It can\. However, `std::function` uses type erasure to implement a unified wrapper, which incurs additional indirect call overhead and may also involve dynamic memory allocation in some cases\. Therefore, it should not be used unconditionally to replace function pointers in all scenarios\.

| 示例 | 讲了什么 | 新出现的语法 | 为什么这样写 | 注意事项 |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| 示例 1 | 创建 array 和基本访问 | `std::array<T, N>`、`size()` | array 大小是编译期常量，`size()` 返回固定值 | 大小必须是编译期常量，不能传变量 |
| 示例 2 | at() 安全访问和 fill() 填充 | `at()`、`fill()` | `at()` 越界会抛异常；`fill()` 方便批量赋值 | `fill()` 对所有元素赋相同值 |
| 示例 3 | 对比 C 数组和 array 传参 | `data()`、`const std::array<int,5>&` | array 传参时大小信息不丢失 | array 大小是类型的一部分，不同大小是不同的类型 |
e889671ff7effb5790030a5fa7a257f762f6e6a0.translatedText:
| Example | What was discussed | Newly introduced syntax | Why it is written this way | Notes |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Example 1 | Creating an array and basic access | `std::array<T, N>`、`size()` | The array size is a compile\-time constant,`size()` returns a fixed value | The size must be a compile\-time constant; you cannot pass a variable |
| Example 2 | Safe access with at() and filling with fill() | `at()`、`fill()` | `at()`An out\-of\-bounds access throws an exception;`fill()` convenient for batch assignment | `fill()`Assigns the same value to all elements |
| Example 3 | Comparing C arrays and array parameter passing | `data()`、`const std::array<int,5>&` | When an array is passed as a parameter, size information is not lost | The array size is part of the type; different sizes are different types |
